tables.name: Place of Worship Size
tables.description: Rolled for each place of worship in the village.

results.name: Secret
results.description: The place of worship’s size is unclear, as the location is not publicly known.

results.name: Altar
results.description: A small shrine or, perhaps, a tiny shack, usually evincing some various items or images relating to that which the faith venerates.

results.name: Oratory
results.description: A modest building with seating for attendees, appointed with various items or images relating to that which the faith venerates.

results.name: Sanctuary
results.description: A large, well-appointed structure, able to comfortably accommodate up to a few hundred people.

results.name: Temple
results.description: A grand building, replete with elements like high ceilings, plush furnishings, and other impressive ornamental and/or architectural features. It can hold nearly a thousand attendees.

results.name: Great Temple
results.description: An awe-inspiring structure, devoted to that which it venerates. No expense was spared in its construction. It might display such elements as stunning frescos, elaborate stained-glass scenes, and towering, gilded statues. Walking into a great temple is a rare and striking experience for those who do not live near one.
